evals.prompt: generate a report for me of what I did from 8am to 1pm today
evals.expected_output: A new one-page file `reports/daily/<git user>/yymmdd.md` with `created`/`updated` frontmatter stamps carrying runtime UTC offsets (no `covers`): Completed Today holds up to 4 outcomes with Why, Result, and one refs line of 2 to 4 pointers (session id, hyperlinked issue or pull request, check short label, or file — never commit hashes, turn numbers, or window tags) backed by queried proof; Under Review, Active Work, Blockers & Risks, Next Up, and Glossary honor their row caps; the body is timeless; any grounding gap is stated explicitly.

evals.prompt: give me the report for the 13h-19h window yesterday - work that finished goes in Done, work still open goes in In Progress
evals.expected_output: Yesterday's per-day file `reports/daily/<git user>/yymmdd.md` (the day of the requested window): the same-day window scopes the grounding query only — the body carries no window; only outcomes finished inside it appear in Completed Today, each backed by a proof row, pull request, or completion statement; work still open appears in Active Work with an honest Current State.

evals.prompt: summarize what got done in this session so far into the daily report file
evals.expected_output: Uses the default window from start of day to the current machine time, collects evidence with the skill's own scripts (Get-GitProof.ps1 and Get-SessionEvidence.ps1 — never another skill's scripts), writes to `reports/daily/<git user>/yymmdd.md`, and updates an existing same-day file in place instead of creating a second one, preserving `created` and refreshing `updated`.

evals.prompt: run the daily report again tonight for today - I already ran it this morning
evals.expected_output: Detects the existing `reports/daily/<git user>/yymmdd.md`, updates it in place (never a second file), preserves `created`, refreshes `updated` with the runtime offset, merges the new outcomes under the one-page budget, and reports that the file was updated.

evals.prompt: I keep sessions from several repositories on this machine - only report this repository's work
evals.expected_output: Runs grounding once per repository in `repo_names` (the current checkout plus each additional repository in the list): git proof and session evidence are merged across repositories, repos outside the list stay out entirely, and a checkout that cannot be resolved is named as a grounding gap rather than silently dropped.

evals.prompt: run today's report - my glossary.md already contains two terms but not the new one from this morning's grill
evals.expected_output: Renders the Glossary after reading `reports/daily/<git user>/glossary.md`: existing terms marked `known` with meanings matching canonical verbatim, the harvested new term marked `NEW` and listed first, at most 8 rows; then upserts through `Merge-Glossary.ps1` and quotes its JSON receipt (added/refreshed/kept/total/changed) in the report-back.

evals.prompt: me and my colleague both run today's report in the shared checkout - give each of us our own file
evals.expected_output: Each run resolves its Step 0 identity and writes only under `reports/daily/<runner git user>/yymmdd.md` with its own `glossary.md`; two users produce two folders for the day, never merging into one file, and a run refuses any path that would land in another user's folder.

evals.prompt: I remember working on something this morning but there is no commit or PR I can point to - put it in the report anyway
evals.expected_output: Refuses to list it as Completed: a Completed item needs a proof row from `Get-GitProof.ps1` (an author-filtered commit in the window, or a working-tree file created in the window), a pull request, or an explicit completion statement; the candidate is dropped or the grounding gap is stated honestly, and uncommitted work appears in Active Work or Blockers with git status as evidence.

evals.prompt: tạo báo cáo ngày hôm qua từ 13h đến 18h cho mình
evals.expected_output: Routes to the daily-report skill from the Vietnamese trigger: yesterday's per-day file under the runner's user folder, the same-day window scoping the grounding only, completed outcomes backed by proof, body timeless with `created`/`updated` frontmatter.

evals.prompt: write the pull request description for #123
evals.expected_output: Does NOT fire the daily-report skill: PR-description writing is a genuine negative and routes elsewhere (or asks to be handled as PR work).

Runs batch mode via `Invoke-DailyReportBatch.ps1`: one day per iteration over the same single-day path (Get-GitProof + Get-SessionEvidence per day), days whose report exists are skipped by default (regenerate only on explicit opt-in), a failing day is reported and the loop continues, and no day leaves a half-written file.

evals.prompt: run today's report again - nothing changed since this morning, no new terms
evals.expected_output: Updates the report in place and reruns `Merge-Glossary.ps1` with `keep` ops: the receipt shows `changed: false`, `glossary.md` is byte-identical (no rewrite), and the report-back states the no-op honestly.

evals.prompt: generate today's report and make sure I can open the transcripts of every session it cites
evals.expected_output: After writing `reports/daily/<git user>/yymmdd.md`, runs `scripts/Export-SessionTranscripts.ps1 -ReportPath <path> -CoverageJson <receipt>`: every session cited in the body (a transcript link `[<8-char id>](sessions/<yymmdd>/<full-uuid>.html)` or a legacy prose id, grill sessions excluded) plus every in-scope session of that day's coverage receipt lands as `sessions/<yymmdd>/<full-session-uuid>.html` beside the report, grouped by the report's date — real turns-only transcript when this machine holds the session, an explicit notice page when it does not — and the JSON receipt (total/exported/notice/kept/pruned) is quoted in the report-back. The slug is always the full UUID, so a stale short-form file is pruned instead of duplicated. `Test-DailyReport.ps1 -CoverageJson <receipt>` fails any report whose cited session lacks its `sessions/<yymmdd>/<full-uuid>.html`, whose transcript link names a short slug or a label that is not the matching 8-char id, whose coverage receipt is missing or unverified, or whose in-scope session has no export; the exported `*.html` files and the receipt are git-ignored.

evals.prompt: from my home-repo, generate today's report across all my watched repos
evals.expected_output: Resolves `reports/daily/daily-report.manifest.json` with `Get-ReportManifest.ps1 -Optional`: the manifest's mode `multi` dictates the run — git proof and session evidence collected once per manifest repo with `exists:true` (a path missing on this machine is named as a grounding gap, never dropped), the rows merged into one report, and the report plus glossary and transcripts written under the tower home-repo's `reports/daily/<git user>/`. The report-back states the active mode and the tower path.

evals.prompt: I keep several checkouts on this machine, but for this run only report this repository
evals.expected_output: The manifest's `mode` dictates the active mode: `mode: "single"` grounds only the invoking checkout against `repo_names` and ignores `repos`, writing to the invoking checkout's `reports/daily/`; with no manifest present the run defaults to single mode. Multi-repo grounding never happens unless the manifest says `multi`.

evals.prompt: before you save yesterday's report, prove that no local Copilot session from that day is missing
evals.expected_output: Runs `Get-SessionCoverage.ps1 -Date <day> -RepoRoot <root> -EvidenceJson <every per-repo evidence file>` and writes `sessions/<yymmdd>/coverage.json`: every session the store held that day is classified inScope / outOfScope / unattributed (nothing silently dropped), the in-scope ids are diffed against what evidence returned (`verified: true`, `missed` empty, `complete: true`), out-of-scope and unattributed sessions are named as grounding gaps in the report-back, and `Test-DailyReport.ps1 -CoverageJson <receipt>` passes only on that complete receipt.
